"""Cross-check the native stages against independent Python implementations."""
import ipaddress, random, struct, subprocess, sys
from bisect import bisect_right
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import native
WIDTH=(16,8,4); LANES=(4,8,16)

def py_runs(routes):
    """routes: dict (start,length)->hop"""
    if not routes: return [0],[None]
    items=sorted(routes.items())
    starts=[];ends=[]
    for (s,l),h in items:
        size=1<<(128-l); starts.append(s); ends.append(s+size)
    pts=sorted(set(starts)|set(ends)|{0,1<<128})
    import heapq
    heap=[];idx=0;runs=[]
    for p in range(len(pts)-1):
        x=pts[p]
        while idx<len(items) and starts[idx]<=x:
            heapq.heappush(heap,(-items[idx][0][1],idx)); idx+=1
        while heap and ends[heap[0][1]]<=x: heapq.heappop(heap)
        hop=items[heap[0][1]][1] if heap else None
        if runs and runs[-1][1]==hop: continue
        runs.append((x,hop))
    return [r[0] for r in runs],[r[1] for r in runs]

def py_image(starts, hops, layout):
    """layout: list of dicts lo,span,mode,cached,children (BFS order)"""
    R=len(starts); N=len(layout)
    off=[]; cur=64
    for node in layout:
        b=len(node['children'])
        keys=b-1 if b else node['span']
        used=32+(4*b if b else 0)+keys*WIDTH[node['mode']]
        off.append(cur); cur+=((used+63)//64)*64
    hopoff=cur
    total=hopoff+((4*R+63)//64)*64
    buf=bytearray(total)
    buf[0:4]=b'FIDX'; buf[4]=2
    struct.pack_into('<IIII',buf,8,R,N,hopoff,total)
    for i,node in enumerate(layout):
        b=len(node['children']); base=starts[node['lo']]
        p=off[i]
        buf[p]=0 if b else 1; buf[p+1]=node['mode']; buf[p+2]=node['cached']
        struct.pack_into('<HHH',buf,p+4,node['lo'],node['span'],b if b else node['span'])
        used=32+(4*b if b else 0)+(b-1 if b else node['span'])*WIDTH[node['mode']]
        struct.pack_into('<I',buf,p+12,((used+63)//64)*64)
        buf[p+16:p+32]=base.to_bytes(16,'little')
        q=p+32
        if b:
            for c,ch in enumerate(node['children']):
                struct.pack_into('<I',buf,q+4*c,off[ch])
            q+=4*b
            for c in range(1,b):
                k=starts[layout[node['children'][c]]['lo']]
                if node['mode']==0: buf[q:q+16]=k.to_bytes(16,'little')
                elif node['mode']==1: struct.pack_into('<Q',buf,q,(k-base))
                else: struct.pack_into('<I',buf,q,(k-base))
                q+=WIDTH[node['mode']]
        else:
            for c in range(node['span']):
                k=starts[node['lo']+c]
                if node['mode']==0: buf[q:q+16]=k.to_bytes(16,'little')
                elif node['mode']==1: struct.pack_into('<Q',buf,q,(k-base))
                else: struct.pack_into('<I',buf,q,(k-base))
                q+=WIDTH[node['mode']]
    for i,h in enumerate(hops):
        struct.pack_into('<I',buf,hopoff+4*i,0xffffffff if h is None else h)
    return bytes(buf).hex()

def py_lookup(image, addr):
    raw=bytes.fromhex(image)
    R,count,hopoff,total=struct.unpack_from('<IIII',raw,8)
    hops=[]
    for v in struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*R,raw,hopoff):
        hops.append(None if v==0xffffffff else v)
    nodes={}; off=64
    for _ in range(count):
        kind,mode,cached,_r,lo,span,num,_r2,alloc=struct.unpack_from('<BBBBHHHHI',raw,off)
        base=int.from_bytes(raw[off+16:off+32],'little')
        at=off+32; children=[]
        if kind==0:
            children=list(struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*num,raw,at)); at+=4*num
            nk=num-1
        else:
            nk=span
        keys=[]
        for _ in range(nk):
            v=int.from_bytes(raw[at:at+WIDTH[mode]],'little')
            keys.append(v+base if mode else v); at+=WIDTH[mode]
        nodes[off]={'kind':kind,'mode':mode,'keys':keys,'children':children,'lo':lo,'span':span}
        off+=alloc
    path=[]; o=64
    while True:
        path.append(o); n=nodes[o]
        c=bisect_right(n['keys'],addr)
        if n['kind']==1:
            run=n['lo']+c-1
            return [hops[run],run,path]
        o=n['children'][c]

def rand_tree(rng,R):
    nodes=[]
    def build(lo,hi):
        span=hi-lo
        if span<=8 or (span>1 and rng.random()<0.4):
            i=len(nodes); nodes.append({'lo':lo,'span':span,'mode':0,'cached':0,'children':[]}); return i
        k=rng.randint(2,min(9,span))
        cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(lo+1,hi),k-1))
        bounds=[lo]+cuts+[hi]
        i=len(nodes); nodes.append({'lo':lo,'span':span,'mode':0,'cached':0,'children':[]})
        for b in range(k):
            nodes[i]['children'].append(build(bounds[b],bounds[b+1]))
        return i
    build(0,R)
    order=[]; queue=[0]
    while queue:
        i=queue.pop(0); order.append(i); queue.extend(nodes[i]['children'])
    remap={o:n for n,o in enumerate(order)}
    out=[]
    for o in order:
        node=dict(nodes[o]); node['children']=[remap[c] for c in node['children']]
        out.append(node)
    return out

def main():
    rng=random.Random(4)
    # ATLAS
    for trial in range(60):
        n=rng.randint(0,25)
        routes={}
        for _ in range(n):
            length=rng.choice([0,8,16,32,64,96,127,128])
            start=(rng.getrandbits(128)>>(128-length) if length else 0)<<(128-length)
            routes[(start,length)]=rng.randint(0,100)
        got_starts,got_hops=native.atlas(routes)
        want_starts,want_hops=py_runs(routes)
        assert got_starts==want_starts, (trial,'atlas starts')
        assert got_hops==want_hops, (trial,'atlas hops')
    print('ATLAS ok')
    # PACK / TRACE
    for trial in range(60):
        R=rng.randint(1,12)
        starts=sorted(rng.sample(range(0,1<<40),R))
        hops=[rng.choice([None,0,1,7,99]) for _ in range(R)]
        layout=rand_tree(rng,R)
        # legal modes
        for node in layout:
            spread=starts[node['lo']+node['span']-1]-starts[node['lo']]
            node['mode']=rng.choice([0,1,2])
            if node['mode']==1 and spread>=(1<<64): node['mode']=0
            if node['mode']==2 and spread>=(1<<32): node['mode']=0
            node['cached']=rng.randint(0,1)
        addresses=[rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,20))]
        image,answers=native.pack(starts,hops,layout,addresses)
        want=py_image(starts,hops,layout)
        assert image==want, (trial,'image mismatch')
        for addr,ans in zip(addresses,answers):
            expect=py_lookup(image,addr)
            assert ans==expect, (trial,'answer mismatch',ans,expect)
        traced=native.trace(image,addresses)
        assert traced==answers, (trial,'trace mismatch')
    print('PACK/TRACE ok')

main()
EOF
